gloss: to roll dice; to throw dice

definitions.gloss: to roll dice; to throw dice
definitions.explanation: Used literally in games, and occasionally figuratively to mean taking a chance.

examples.japanese: サイコロを{振|ふ}って⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I rolled the dice and got a six.

examples.japanese: ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧サイコロを{振|ふ}って⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please roll the dice in order.

examples.japanese: すごろく⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧とき、サイコロを{振|ふ}って⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: When playing sugoroku, you roll the dice and advance the number shown.

notes:
The standard expression for rolling dice in Japanese. ⟦サイコロ→サイコロ：06524_saikoro⟧ (dice) comes from Portuguese (or possibly from {賽|さい}, an older word for dice, combined with コロ suggesting rolling). The verb ⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ means to shake or swing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦サイコロ→サイコロ：06524_saikoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to roll two dice
- ⟦サイコロ→サイコロ：06524_saikoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: the number shown on a die face
- ⟦サイコロ→サイコロ：06524_saikoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: the result comes up
- ⟦サイコロ→サイコロ：06524_saikoro⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧: dice games

RELATED WORDS:
- {賽|さい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{投|な}げられた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧: the die is cast (figurative, from Caesar)
- ⟦サイコロ→サイコロ：06524_saikoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{転|ころ}がす→転がす：02521_korogasu⟧: to roll dice (alternative verb)

USAGE:
⟦サイコロ→サイコロ：06524_saikoro⟧ can also be written as {骰子|さいころ} in kanji, though the katakana form is standard. The word {賽|さい} alone can mean dice in more literary contexts.
